card.name: Digits inside dose and strength numbers
card.fires_on: Digits (and a slash) inside strengths and concentrations such as 0.07%, 75 mcg, 10 mg/mL or 5% dextrose, usually right before a unit or percent sign. A few hits fall inside URLs.

modes.label: Digits in strengths
modes.description: A digit within a drug strength or percentage, with the number not yet finished.
modes.example: contact lenses. Lenses may be reinserted after 10 minutes following administration of bromfenac ophthalmic solution, 0.0<<7>>%.

modes.label: Slash in mg/mL
modes.description: The slash between mg and mL in a concentration.
modes.example: ONLY. BEFORE ADMINISTRATION, THIS PHARMACY BULK PACKAGE REQUIRES RECONSTITUTION TO A CONCENTRATION OF 100 MG<</>>ML AND FURTHER DILUTION

modes.label: Inside a URL
modes.description: Part of a word inside a web address slug.

card.writes: It suppresses closing-tag text like '</' and so favors the number or unit continuing instead of markup.
card.plain: It fires on the digits in a dose or strength, such as the 7 in 0.07%, while the number is still being written.
